public_rationale: On January 9, 2026, Hegseth signed a memo directing the department to become an 'AI-first' warfighting force 'across all components, from front to back'. The memo says speed wins and that the risk of moving too slowly outweighs the risk of imperfect alignment. In January he also gave a speech at SpaceX rejecting AI models that won't let the military fight wars. This fits the plain reading: broad, fast AI deployment is a signature, publicly championed priority of his tenure. What he privately thinks about his career cannot be checked, so the grade rests on his public record.
limitations: The motive behind it cannot be observed; the grade rests on public directives and speeches.
The memo was read from a third-party mirror because the official copy returned 403.
